correction_2026_10_09: SEPARATOR CORRECTION, 2026-10-09. Every row in this file that spelled a binding `<callable>#<binding>` now spells it with `BINDING_SEP` as the family defines it — U+0000, written `\u0000` in JSON. The character was `#` until src/ast/types.ts commit c95c8485f ("the binding separator was `#` — a character nine lanes legitimately publish, so their claims were unverifiable"): `#` is a real key character in other lanes (a CSS id selector, a markdown label, an HCL address), so `verifyBindingClaim` had to reject every binding claim on a run that also published one. The edges, their lines, their confidence and their metadata are UNCHANGED; only the separator character moved. Measured before this correction: `npx tsx script/m14/run-fixtures.ts --lang dart` -> {"dart":{"pass":21,"fail":7}}, and all 7 failures were rows whose sole difference was this character. Any `#` still visible in this file's prose is the 2026-10-08 spelling quoted as history, not the current one.
authoredNote: The expected line numbers below were TRANSCRIBED from a measured run of this fixture through the production entry (RealDartAnalyzer.analyze) and then checked LINE BY LINE against the source with the claimed line's own text printed under each edge (script/m14/tmp/dt-fixture-dump.ts) — so they record what the analyzer does, not what it ought to. What makes them constraints rather than a snapshot is the forbid set: every entry there is a construct-start position the Dart grammar permits writing (a wrapped directive, a wrapped member type, a wrapped heritage clause, a receiver-continued selector, a wrapped redirect target) and three of them (contains @45, @48, @54) are the MEASURED pre-fix positions of this very file.
rationale: M60 line contract, dart lane (#929 lineage). dart emitted NO line_number on any relationship before this round: MEASURED 42,310 edges over a 240-file draw of both pinned corpora (proxicall + dart-http) with 0 lined - every one of the 32 inline `relationships.push` sites unlined, since the analyzer had no line helper at all. It now has one (`nodeLine(node)`), the four text-only helpers gained node-returning forms (`lastIdentifierNode`, `linkMemberNode`, `resolveSelectorCalleeNode`, `resolvedHeritageNodes`, `signatureNameNode`) so the TEXT and the LINE of an edge can never come from two different selections, and all 32 sites carry the field. Measured on the same draws: 0 of 32,016 (120 files) and 0 of 42,310 (240 files) unlined, 0 lines outside their file, and a name-token check over 31,866 checkable edges reports 0 INCONSISTENT (the 150 exempted edges are `contains -> constructor`, a SYNTHESISED name and the kotlin/phantom class). The change is provably ADDITIVE: script/m14/tmp/dt-lines-equivalence.ts compares every payload field with `line_number` stripped against HEAD's analyzer on the same files - 0 payload-different files (identical symbols, identical edge multisets, identical label histogram). Two of the traps are the round's own discoveries: (a) a WRAPPED member declaration (`final void Function(int a,\n    int b) _wrapped;`, the shape of cronet_http's generated jni_bindings.dart) put the edge on the declaration's START line - a line the member name is not written on - for 148 of 32,016 edges on the equivalence draw, fixed by recording each member's NAME line at symbol creation (`nameLines`, keyed by name+range because one declaration node can carry several names); (b) the node-form refactor of `signatureName` briefly published the raw operator token (`==`) instead of the contract spelling (`operator ==`) for operator overloads, and the same equivalence proof caught it on cupertino_api.dart before any fixture was written. Reverting mutant: dart/lines-dropped (strips every line - the exact pre-fix state) plus dart/line-zero-based (the off-by-one that proves the fixture pins the arithmetic, not merely the presence of a number).
